# Drupal fixtures

`issue-*.json` are trimmed copies of live, public drupalorg-cli 0.15.0 JSON
responses retrieved on 2026-11-07. Titles, identifiers, statuses and comment
text are unchanged; the comment list is reduced to keep the fixtures small.
Each file records its source URL and retrieval time in `_fixture`.

`commits.json` and `commit-refs.json` are derived from the public
git.drupalcode.org API for the Drupal Core 11.4.12 analysis. They are fixtures,
not a substitute for checking the live refs when refreshing evidence.

These fixtures are public Drupal.org content, not private tracker material.
